tool_schemas.name: execute_sql
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided ad-hoc SQL text against the Microsoft SQL Server data source configured for the given active session and returns execution metadata along with a result preview (up to max_rows_sample rows) while recording the full execution, sampled rows, and any errors in the audit trail. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if session_id is not a valid mcp_sess_ ULID, sql_text is empty, max_rows_sample is negative, or unknown fields are provided in the request. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the session, NOT_FOUND if the session_id does not exist or is not active, and CONFLICT if the session is in a state that cannot accept executions (e.g., closed/expired) or the data source configuration is not available for the session.

session_id.description: Active MCP session ULID (mcp_sess_...) to execute the SQL under.

sql_text.description: Ad-hoc SQL text to execute against the session's configured Microsoft SQL Server datasource.

request_context.description: Optional request metadata to store alongside the execution for audit/observability (e.g., user, trace ids, client details).

max_rows_sample.description: Maximum number of rows to include in the stored/returned result sample (results may still be truncated).

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity derived from the presented API key, including the resolved workspace, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for this key and workspace. Refuses with AUTHENTICATION_ERROR if the API key is missing/invalid or revoked/expired.

api_key.description: API key credential presented to authenticate the request (same value used to authorize other endpoints).

tool_schemas.name: create_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new active session for the authenticated workspace, optionally binding it to a specific datasource. Requires the API key to include the 'execute_sql' scope. Returns the created session record (including session_id and expires_at). Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if scope is missing, VALIDATION_ERROR if datasource is not in the workspace, and CONFLICT_ERROR if the workspace/session policy prevents creation.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate and authorize session creation.

datasource_id.description: Optional datasource ULID (mcp_ds_...) to bind this session to; if omitted, execute_sql resolves to the workspace default datasource.

client_info.description: Optional client metadata to store on the session (e.g., app name/version, host, user agent).

ttl_seconds.description: Optional session lifetime in seconds; if omitted, the server default is used (subject to policy).

tool_schemas.name: revoke_session
tool_schemas.description: Revokes an active session immediately (status -> revoked). Returns the updated session. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the session_id does not exist in the authenticated workspace, and VALIDATION_ERROR if the session is not in a revocable state.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate and authorize the request.

reason.description: Optional reason to record for the revocation (for audit/incident response).

tool_schemas.name: list_datasources
tool_schemas.description: Lists datasources in the authenticated workspace with optional status filtering and pagination. Returns datasource records excluding stored secrets (passwords are never returned; only password_secret_ref may be returned). Refuses with AUTHENTICATION_ERROR if the API key is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the request.

name_prefix.description: Optional prefix match filter on datasource name.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list call.

tool_schemas.name: create_datasource
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new datasource configuration in the authenticated workspace. Returns the created datasource record; secrets are not echoed back (password is accepted but never returned). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid connection properties/auth_mode, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the API key is not permitted to manage datasources.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate and authorize the request.

server_host.description: SQL Server host (DNS name or IP).

database_name.description: Default database name to connect to.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode to use when connecting.

username.description: Username for auth modes that require it (e.g., sql_login, azure_ad_password).

password.description: Password/secret for auth modes that require it. Stored securely and never returned.

encrypt.description: Whether to require encrypted connections (recommended true).

trust_server_certificate.description: Whether to trust the server certificate without validation (use only for dev/self-signed).

set_as_workspace_default.description: If true, sets this datasource as the workspace default_datasource_id upon creation.

tool_schemas.name: update_datasource_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a datasource lifecycle status in the authenticated workspace (active <-> disabled, active/disabled -> deleted). Returns the updated datasource. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if the requested transition is not allowed, and CONFLICT_ERROR if the datasource is in use by policy.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate and authorize the request.

status.description: Target lifecycle status; must be a valid transition from the current status.
